concept_en: When to Deflect a Defender Before Sacrificing
question_cn: 当黑方有两个车守护王的角落时（如g7和g8各有一车），为何不能直接弃后？
question_en: If Black has two rooks defending the king's corner, such as on g7 and g8, why can't White sacrifice the queen immediately?

options.text_cn: 直接弃后子力损失太大
options.text_en: A direct queen sacrifice loses too much material

options.text_cn: 弃后后对方仍有棋子保护将杀格，直接弃后无效
options.text_en: After the queen sacrifice, another piece still guards the mating square, so the sacrifice does not work yet

options.text_cn: 弃后会让王逃跑到中心
options.text_en: The queen sacrifice lets the king escape to the center

options.text_cn: 对方的马会吃掉白方的车
options.text_en: The opponent's knight will capture White's rook

explanation_cn: 当两个黑车都守护将杀格时，直接弃后后对方还有一个车保护，白方无法将死。必须先用引离手法（如Rg4引走一个车），再弃后才能成功。
explanation_en: If both rooks defend the mating square, a direct queen sacrifice leaves one rook still protecting it, so there is no mate. First deflect one rook, for example with Rg4, then the queen sacrifice can succeed.
